original_question: 我正在为多光谱成像相机设计一片可见-近红外双波段分光膜。要求可见光波段 450-650 nm 尽可能高的反射率（用于 RGB 通道成像），同时近红外波段 700-1000 nm 尽可能高的透过率（用于 NIR 通道）。请在 45 度入射、熔融石英基底条件下，仅使用 TiO2 和 SiO2 设计一个平面多层介质膜，膜系总层数不超过 24 层。采用非偏振光（s、p 偏振等权平均）；各波段目标均定义为按波长积分后除以波段宽度的平均值。
user_objective: Design a planar TiO2/SiO2 visible–NIR dichroic multilayer coating for multispectral imaging, maximizing wavelength-integral mean RGB reflectance and NIR transmittance at 45 degrees with equal-s/p unpolarized light under the stated constraints.

subgoals.objective: Maximize visible-band reflectance for RGB imaging
subgoals.original_span: 可见光波段 450-650 nm 尽可能高的反射率（用于 RGB 通道成像）
subgoals.operational_definition: Wavelength integral of the specified optical quantity over the band, divided by band width, for equal-s/p unpolarized light at 45 degrees.

subgoals.original_span: 近红外波段 700-1000 nm 尽可能高的透过率（用于 NIR 通道）
subgoals.operational_definition: Wavelength integral of the specified optical quantity over the band, divided by band width, for equal-s/p unpolarized light at 45 degrees.

application_intents.intent: Multispectral imaging with RGB and NIR channels
